edits.value_json: "EMPTY -> FULL on input transfer when no same-edge output transfer; FULL -> EMPTY on output transfer when no same-edge input transfer; FULL -> FULL when output transfer and input transfer both occur on the same rising edge (simultaneous dequeue/enqueue allowed only when FULL at cycle start and out_ready=1, with in_ready asserted in that cycle). In no-backpressure steady operation (out_ready=1), design accepts one input every cycle after initial fill."
edits.reason: Fixes throughput/latency conflict by explicitly allowing same-cycle dequeue/enqueue in FULL when output is consumed.

edits.value_json: "single-cycle compute from accepted input to output register visibility next cycle; if output transfer occurs in a cycle, register may be refilled by a newly accepted input on that same edge"
edits.reason: Aligns schedule with allowed same-edge dequeue/enqueue behavior.

edits.value_json: "DUT deasserts in_ready only when output register is occupied and not being consumed in the current cycle, or when reset asserted; if occupied and out_ready=1, in_ready remains asserted to permit same-edge replace"
edits.reason: Makes channel-level ready behavior consistent with no-bubble operation.

edits.value_json: "Input ready; high when rst_n=1 and either output register is empty or will be consumed this cycle (out_valid&&out_ready), enabling same-edge dequeue/enqueue."
edits.reason: Freezes implementable port-level rule for in_ready under FULL+out_ready.

edits.value_json: "Exact no-stall latency: if an input transfer occurs at cycle t (in_valid&&in_ready sampled high at rising edge with rst_n=1), its corresponding output is presented with out_valid=1 at cycle t+1. If out_ready=1 at t+1, transfer occurs at t+1. With continuous in_valid=1 and out_ready=1, one transfer per cycle is sustained after pipeline fill via same-edge dequeue/enqueue of the single-entry output register. Backpressure on out_ready delays only output transfer of the head item and forces in_ready low until release."
edits.reason: Removes ambiguity and preserves one-cycle latency without throughput bubbles.

edits.value_json: "on cycle with rst_n=0 at rising edge: out_valid=0, in_ready=0, out_sum driven to 0, pending/pre-reset work discarded; no input or output transfer is accepted on that edge"
edits.reason: Resolves reset/output-value ambiguity with explicit executable out_sum rule.

edits.value_json: "Synchronous active-low reset; when 0 at rising edge, clears output-valid state, forces out_sum to 0, discards pending work, drives in_ready low for that cycle, and suppresses transfer acceptance on both channels for that edge."
edits.reason: Keeps reset signal semantics consistent with architecture reset contract.
